messages:
Aisha: quick flag from onboarding: our vite+swc sample app hits an auth/retry loop when deployed to edge. First request OK, token refresh triggers, then subsequent calls 401 and SDK keeps retrying.
Tom: annoying. minimal repro?
Aisha: repo uses Vite 4 + swc + target="edge". Code is a single edge handler importing default from '@redwood-inference/sdk'. Build succeeds but edge runtime logs: `TypeError: default is not a function`.
Riley: that usually means bundler picked CJS build and runtime got a namespace object. Any package.json exports?
Aisha: SDK has main -> dist/cjs/index.js and module -> dist/esm/index.mjs but no exports. Vite/rollup ended up bundling the cjs variant.
Tom: local fix: set resolve.mainFields = ['module','main'] or alias to the ESM file. Workaround: optimizeDeps.exclude the SDK during dev.
Aisha: note: TS also suggests `export =` style in editor which confuses users.
Riley: plan: add exports map in package.json (import/require), publish types with explicit default + named exports, and add a short DX note about module-first resolution for edge builds.
DevBot: created issue #1410 with repro and added failing sampleapp CI job.
Tom: I'll draft the exports/types PR. Riley, can you add a tiny example under examples/vite-edge-auth-repro showing failing vs patched configs?
Riley: yep, will add and link in the issue.
